instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem:
An adult is receiving electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) under general anesthesia. At 185 seconds after the stimulus, rhythmic motor activity continues in the isolated limb, and the EEG continues to show ictal activity. The anesthesia professional and ECT physician are at the bedside, and protocol orders for seizure termination are active. The client has not regained consciousness and has no new focal neurologic finding.

Complete the bowtie by selecting the most likely condition, the 2 priority actions, and the 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Administer the protocol-directed anesthetic or anticonvulsant to terminate the seizure

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Maintain the airway and provide assisted ventilation and oxygenation

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Continue observation without treatment while waiting for the seizure to stop on its own

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Depression symptom score during the event

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: Oxygen saturation, ventilation, pulse, and blood pressure

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Motor and EEG seizure cessation and recurrence
